# Incidence questions yield a common relational refinement

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`incidence-common-refinement` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F22 · [record](incidence-common-refinement.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> For two joinings connected from roots alike through their role frames, the alike fragment pairs form a common refinement whose projections keep joins, lift each join at one participant and cover both; with excluded middle and both locally finite, roots passing the same branching tests suffice.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A joining read through roles is the frame whose places are fragments and occurrences of joining: a fragment enters an occurrence by a role it holds there, and an occurrence is left by a role to the fragment holding it. A joining is connected from a fragment where every fragment is reached from it through roles. (`Becoming.Joining.roleFrame`, `Becoming.Joining.ConnectedFrom`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. An open map of joinings keeps the joining, and lifts every occurrence holding a fragment's image in a role to an occurrence holding that fragment in that role, mapped onto it role by role; it lifts pairs where every joining of two images comes from a joining of the two fragments. (`Becoming.Joining.Keeps`, `Becoming.Joining.OpenMap`, `Becoming.Joining.PairLifting`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. For any two joinings, the pairs of fragments alike through their role frames, joined pair by pair, form a joining whose two projections are open maps of joinings, with no premise. (`Becoming.Joining.Matched`, `Becoming.Joining.span`, `Becoming.Joining.span_first_open`, `Becoming.Joining.span_second_open`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. For two joinings connected from roots alike through their role frames, every fragment of either is alike to some fragment of the other, so the joining of alike pairs is a common refinement: both projections are open and every fragment of each joining is a projection of an alike pair; no finiteness and no decision is used. (`Becoming.Joining.covers`, `Becoming.Joining.common_refinement`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. With excluded middle as a named hypothesis, configurations of two frames passing the same branching tests match each step where the second frame lists the outcomes of each move, and passing the same tests is a bisimulation where both frames list them. (`Becoming.SameBranchingTests.step_of_em`, `Becoming.SameBranchingTests.bisimulation_of_em`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. With excluded middle as a named hypothesis, where each fragment of two joinings holds each role in listed occurrences, places are alike through the role frames exactly where they pass the same branching tests. (`Becoming.Joining.LocallyFinite`, `Becoming.Joining.LocallyFinite.alike_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. With excluded middle as a named hypothesis and each fragment of the second joining holding each role in listed occurrences: where fragments x and y pass the same tests of roles, an occurrence of the first holding x in a role is matched by one of the second holding y in that role, their fragments in every role passing the same tests; with both so listed, roots passing the same tests cover what they connect. (`Becoming.Joining.match_incident_of_em`, `Becoming.Joining.covers_of_em`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
8. With excluded middle as a named hypothesis, for two joinings in which each fragment holds each role in listed occurrences, connected from roots passing the same branching tests of roles, the joining of alike pairs is a common refinement whose projections are open and cover both. (`Becoming.Joining.common_refinement_of_em`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
9. Where every fragment takes every role and some fragment cannot join itself, the map onto the one-fragment joining is open, every fragment passing the tests of roles of the one fragment, and does not lift pairs; for the process that moves once, the map of its traced fragments onto that joining is open and does not lift pairs. (`Becoming.Joining.RoleTotal.open_not_pairLifting`, `Becoming.Fragment.once_open_not_pairLifting`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Two partial ternary joining laws J and K, possibly on different fragment types; the same finite branch language over six role movements.
- Both joinings are connected from their roots (ConnectedFrom on both sides), the roots alike through the role frames or, for the tests form, passing the same branching tests with finitely many incident joins per fragment and role.
- The form with roots passing the same branching tests takes excluded middle as a named hypothesis (em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p) and both joinings locally finite; the form with alike roots takes neither.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Lifting each join at one participant does not give lifting at a fixed pair: an open map of joinings can fail to lift pairs. Witness: `Becoming.Fragment.once_open_not_pairLifting`.
- Read through roles alone, a joining with local units collapses: every traced fragment of a process passes the tests of the one fragment. Witness: `Becoming.Fragment.traces_collapse`.
- It shows neither one actual provenance shared by the two descriptions nor a universal ontology.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Machine-checked: core receipts under becoming-checks (check_becoming.py, Lean 4.29.1) bind the current bytes of Becoming.Joining, Becoming.JoiningRoles, Becoming.Granularity and Becoming.BranchingCorrespondence, every declaration the laws cite with an empty axiom report. The periphery modules the laws were ported from are provenance, their receipt under explanatory-joining-refinement-checks keeping its earlier scope. No independent review.

Canonical source: [Joining.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Joining.lean)

### History

- 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): restated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Two joinings with alike roots, from which every fragment is reached, have a common refinement, the joining of their alike pairs, whose two projections are open and cover both, with no finiteness and no decision (Joining.common_refinement); under the periphery's hypotheses, local finiteness and roots passing the same tests, with excluded middle, so do they (Joining.common_refinement_of_em). The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
